newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Hug to leave Credit Suisse Group.
newsitem.headline: Hug to leave Credit Suisse Group.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston executive board member Rudolf Hug has decided to leave Credit Suisse Group to pursue other interests, Credit Suisse said in a statement.

As a member of the executive board of Credit Suisse from 1987 to 1996, Hug was initially responsible for commercial banking, North America and various Swiss branches. From 1993 he was head of the International business section.

As part of the reorganisation of Credit Suisse Group, Hug was appointed to the executive board of Credit Suisse First Boston with responsibility for country management. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
